reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper that every server and client path already calls.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the now-obsolete rounding variant is removed instead of kept beside the new rule.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the home of the scheduled-amount helper.

scope.why: Helper change, removal of the one caller's obsolete rounding argument, updated comments and a unit test.

maintainability.why: A single short, tested definition of the expected amount with no leftover options.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template, forecast, schedules/app, preview and desktop-client.
